format: 9:16 vertical, 15 seconds, 1080x1920, for Heartside's own channels (organic, not paid ads)
goal: Launch the illustrated mug: one photo of your dog becomes a painting all the way round a mug. Serves the North Star (Shopify net sales).

approved.words: I'm happy if you, for this purpose only, focus on the fact that this system works and each part of the machine is doing its job correctly and proportionately. You're authorised to produce a short video as an output but I don't think I'm going to be using your storyboard above in real life.
approved.feedback: I find these storyboards okay but they're just generic ads. They look more like paid ads rather than organic social and they don't have any humour, any magic, any uniqueness about them. They're not thumb-stopping as such.
